summary: The cut is mostly clean, but the shot opens with his head cropped and no point at camera, so it misses the "he points at us" idea.

faults.what: His head is cut off by the top of frame from 48.49 to 48.59, so the opening frames have a headless subject. The face only enters at 48.63. The opening is also washed out with a white fade over the first 3 tiles.
faults.fix: Start the camera lower or tilted up so the head is in frame on the first frame, or trim the washed-out frames.

faults.what: The idea is that he points at us. Through 48.73 both hands are on his hips and no point appears. The arms form a near-symmetrical, twinned akimbo pose with a stiff, flat line of action.
faults.fix: Put the point on the beat of the drop, with one arm extended toward camera. Break the symmetry with a hip shift and a head tilt.

faults.what: From 48.59 to 48.63 the torso drops in frame while the background holds, which reads as a fast settle with no anticipation. The legs stay planted and stiff.
faults.fix: Add a short dip before the rise, or ease the torso move over 2 to 3 more frames.
